failure_patterns.pattern: quantifier_miss: Added an unsupported converse that every permitted parameter occurs, or replaced separate witnesses for each order with one uniform realizing space.

rejected_edits.content: - To test an invariance claim, determine how the defining data transform and whether the proposed quantity remains unchanged under the relevant equivalences. Dimension counts alone do not establish or refute invariance.

- A lower bound on a liminf growth exponent need not imply a uniform lower bound with a fixed constant at that exact exponent; subpolynomial losses may remain. Check the endpoint strength of the stated conclusion.

- In a probabilistic classification, distinguish “the limit almost surely belongs to this finite list” from “each listed limit occurs with positive probability.” Treat per-index probability claims and joint claims, such as eventual residence in a region together with convergence, as separate assertions requiring support.
